feeds.description: Thoughts, expertise and musings about todays health-related issues, by the physicians at The Urology Group.

feeds.title: Urology Gold Journal
feeds.description: The mission of Urology, the 'GOLD JOURNAL', is to provide practical, timely, and relevant clinical and basic science information to physicians and researchers practicing the art of urology worldwide. Urology publishes original articles relating to adult and pediatric clinical urology as well as to clinical and basic science research.

feeds.title: Urology of Virginia
feeds.description: Urology of Virginia is Virginia's resource for information on urological conditions and treatments.

feeds.title: The Urology Hospital
feeds.description: The Urology Hospital blog is providing the industry with the newest and most exciting developments in the field of urology.

feeds.title: Urology Centers of Alabama Blog
feeds.description: At Urology Centers of Alabama, their mission is to provide state-of-the-art, patient-centered urological care with integrity and compassion.

feeds.title: Urology Experts
feeds.description: Experts provide personalized care that puts the patient first. As one of the premier Urology Centers in Southwest Florida, they offer complete radiology and imaging services to get patients back on the road to health.

feeds.title: Philadelphia Urology Associates Blog
feeds.description: Philadelphia Urology Associates offers expert and experienced care to those experiencing urologic issues. Their specialties include: sexual dysfunction, cancer, kidney stones, urinary incontinence, prostate problems, erectile dysfunction, vasectomies, impotence, and penile implants.

feeds.title: Khosla Stone Kidney & Surgical Centre Blog
feeds.description: Here in this blog you can find the latest news, hospital events and camps information, latest surgeries, procedures and technology updates from Khosla Stone Kidney & Surgical Centre blog. A kidney specialist in Ludhiana, Dr Rajesh Khosla, provides kidney stone treatment based on international standards. We offer emergency care with quality equipment to enhance the success rate of the results.

feeds.title: Renal & Urology News
feeds.description: Renal & Urology News publishes timely news coverage of scientific developments of interest to nephrologists and urologists, including in-depth coverage of all relevant medical conferences. All of the news and departments from the print edition are fully archived on the site.

feeds.title: Pacific Coast Urology Medical Center - Robert G. Pugach Blog
feeds.description: Pacific Coast Urology Medical Center is a leader in the diagnosis and treatment of urologic problems.

feeds.title: DR KUAN'S UROLOGY FOR MEN Blog
feeds.description: Urology For Men is a starting point in overcoming the information gap surrounding many mens health issues, which are often undiagnosed, but simple to treat.

feeds.title: UrologyWeb - Dr. Bert Vorstman Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Bert Vorstman was a Board Certified urological surgeon till retirement. After training at the Otago Medical School in Dunedin, New Zealand he completed a urology residency at Auckland Hospital, Auckland, New Zealand.

feeds.title: Georgia Urology Blog
feeds.description: Georgia Urology is the largest urology practice in Atlanta and the Southeast. Comprised of more than 40 of Atlanta's top urologists, including many who are fellowship trained and have advanced specialty training in oncology, laparoscopy, infertility, incontinence and pediatrics, Georgia Urology provides convenient care in 31 offices and ambulatory surgery centers through out the Atlanta metro area.

feeds.title: Uroweb - European Association of Urology (EAU)
feeds.description: The EAU is a non-profit organisation which supports medical professionals working in the field of urology through many of its scientific, professional, educational and awareness-building initiatives.

feeds.title: Arkansas Urology Blog
feeds.description: Arkansas Urology is the largest urology practice in Arkansas and continues to offer the latest innovations in medical technology and surgical techniques to patients with a variety of urological conditions.
